name: niimblue-mcp
description: Design NIIMBOT labels, see NiimBlue's exact 1-bit print preview, and open them in NiimBlue to print.

interface.shortDescription: Design NIIMBOT labels with an exact print preview
interface.longDescription: Lays out text, icons, QR codes and barcodes for NIIMBOT label printers (D11, D110, B1, B21 and more), renders the exact 1-bit image the printhead burns with NiimBlue's own code in headless Chrome or Edge, flags anything that will print badly, and returns a link that opens the label in NiimBlue for printing. It never prints or talks to a printer.
defaultPrompt: Make a pantry jar label for flour on my B1 with 50x30 mm stock.
Make a cable flag for my NAS power cable on a D11.
Make an asset tag for LT-0042 with a QR code to https://inv.example.com/a/LT-0042.
